caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a ceramic pitcher with a pronounced curved handle and spout, rendered in shades of gray, brown, and cream. The body of the pitcher features raised decorative motifs resembling leaves and organic patterns that give it an embossed texture. The handle is substantial with flowing, irregular contours, and the rim and base of the pitcher are outlined with a darker shade. Below and to the left of the main pitcher image, there is a small, simple outline sketch of the same pitcher in profile, including its height ("8 1/4") and another number beside it. In the lower right corner, there is a small drawing showing a view from above (top view) of the pitcher’s opening, revealing a roughly triangular shape with rounded corners. The overall composition is set against a plain, light-colored background, enclosed within a rectangular frame.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
